notes.title: New race tracks
notes.notes:
I have added  new race tracks that will eventually be in the bendy bus racing league. for now they are mixed in the all the other tracks but feature a (BBRL) tag. :)  I hope you enjoy.

Also added 1 Race set on the red planet.

I have also baked new light maps for all races.

All reflection probes in the game have been adjusted or removed to increase frame rate.

I wanted to take a moment to reassure everyone that all the obvious bugs you may notice are hopefully on my radar and I have a big list of improvements/refinements I'm working through. :)

That being said I still want to hear your thoughts on any and all areas of the game, the more we communicate the better the game will become. Thanks again for downloading Quantum Apex!
